title_as_printed: Protocol of a Phase II Randomized, Multi-Center, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial of S-Adenosyl Methionine in Participants with Mild Cognitive Impairment or Dementia Due to Alzheimer's Disease
blind_first: blind codes were written to this file before the registry codes file was opened

blind_codes.Sample_N: 60 planned (30 per arm); protocol, no participants analysed

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: 60 planned (30 per arm) - protocol, no participants analysed

Task_Type.reason: Phase II RCT protocol (trial; no results).

Category.reason: Two readings. C3 alone: the primary outcome (plasma p-tau181) and the epigenetic secondary outcome (DNA methylation) are molecular/fluid. C3;C5: the trial also collects a clinical cognitive battery (RBANS as a secondary outcome; MMSE, CDR, CVLT-3, MoCA, DSST exploratory). The registry keeps the primary domain and omits the secondary C5, which the definitions class as defensible.
Category.quote: The primary outcome is change in plasma p-tau181 concentration between baseline and following 180 days of treatment, which will be compared between the active and placebo group. Secondary outcomes are the safety of SAMe administration (incidence of serious adverse events), change from baseline in cognitive performance (as measured by the Repeatable Battery for the Assessment of Neuropsychological Status), and epigenetic changes in DNA methylation.

Validation_Type.reason: Trial protocol; no predictive model (V2 by convention).

Sample_N_Approx.reason: 'the total sample size for the study is 60 (30 per arm)' (p. 6); no participants analysed yet, and the registry string says so.

Publication_Year.reason: J Prev Alz Dis 2023, Volume 10, Number 4; published online May 15, 2023.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Melbourne multi-centre trial; ADNI not used.
